english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something happens at last, especially after a delay or difficulty.
Use this when the result finally happens after waiting, trouble, or delay.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou2 fan6 gung1 laa3

examples.english: I queued for an hour, and eventually I managed to buy tickets.
examples.traditional: 排咗成個鐘頭隊，我終於買到飛喇。
examples.jyutping: paai4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 tau4 deoi6 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 maai5 dou2 fei1 laa3
